personal.title: Node.js + .NET / C# + Python Full Stack Tech Lead
personal.summary: Full Stack Technical Lead with 8+ years building enterprise applications across Node.js (Express, NestJS), .NET 8 / C# (ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework Core) and Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask) with React, Next.js, Angular and TypeScript on the front end.
